title: Derived restriction square under a scheme isomorphism
statement: Let s:X≅Y be a scheme isomorphism [def-pc-scheme], with chosen derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] on both schemes and all their localized open sites in the same morphism universe. Suppose e:D(O_X)≌D(O_Y) has a specified comparison Q_X⋙e.functor≅(termwise pushforward along s.hom)⋙Q_Y. For every open U of Y there is an equivalence eU between the chosen derived categories on the localized sites at s.hom inverse-image U and at U, and a natural isomorphism e.functor⋙restriction_Y,U≅restriction_X,s⁻¹U⋙eU.functor. No adjunctions, quasi-coherence, perfection or support condition is assumed.

source.place: Isomorphism transport in the affine setup of Tag 09IR; explicit formal restriction comparison in step 1 of lem-pc-affine-derived-open-transport

proof.text: Put V=s.hom inverse-image U and i=s.hom.preimageIso U. Compose overEquiv V, the module pushforward equivalence of i, and (overEquiv U).symm to get an exact equivalence eO on the localized module sites. Its derived equivalence is eO.mapDerivedCategory. Identify both global and open pushforwards with restriction along the inverse isomorphism by Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq.

Prove U.ι≫s.inv=i.inv≫V.ι by cancelling s.hom and using preimageIso_inv_ι. Compose overFunctorEquiv, restrictFunctorComp and restrictFunctorCongr of this equality to identify (global pushforward⋙overFunctor U)⋙overEquiv U.functor with (overFunctor V⋙overEquiv V.functor)⋙open pushforward. Insert the unit of overEquiv U and reassociate to remove the last overEquiv U.functor, obtaining the underived square with eO.functor.

Install the given he as a Localization.Lifting. Use Localization.liftNatIso to identify e.functor with the derived global pushforward. Localize the underived square using mapDerivedCategoryNatIso and the two mapDerivedCategoryCompIso comparisons. Whisker the identification of e.functor with this derived square to obtain the required natural isomorphism.
